license_note: The official model card releases these weights under CC-BY-NC-4.0 and requires compliance with the Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy, which the license incorporates by reference. The noncommercial limit and the use restrictions mean the public weights are not an open-source distribution; commercial use goes through separate Cohere API terms.

license_evidence.scope: CohereLabs aya-vision-32b weights and model release under Cohere's CC-BY-NC 4.0 license with acceptable-use addendum
Mandatory acceptable-use restrictions incorporated by reference into the CC-BY-NC license and named on the official model card

access_boundary: This record represents the CohereLabs/aya-vision-32b weight release of March 2025 with image and text input and text output, together with the hosted c4ai-aya-vision-32b Chat API model. The 8B sibling, the Expanse text lines, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Gated 32B vision-language weights under explicit CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus acceptable-use terms
Cohere's docs serve c4ai-aya-vision-32b on the Chat API with image input
tradeoffs: Gated access and noncommercial-only weights keep this out of open-source distribution
Self-operation needs a non-stock transformers build for the vision adapter
